design: EVOLUTIONARY RULE-LIBRARY LOOP (as briefed): a MAP-Elites/GP archive of interpretable position rules over a pre-registered grammar of causal OHLC terminals (lagged returns, MA/Donchian/Bollinger, Yang-Zhang/Parkinson/GK range vol, dollar-volume rank, cross-sectional rank/z, beta, VR(30) regime flag) with sizing and holding-frequency operators; population 500 x <=50 generations = 25,000 evaluations on the PIT 273-asset daily panel 2018-10 -> 2025-12; fitness = "median CPCV-OOS-path" net@21 per-decision Sharpe via the unmodified trader.backtest.cell_metrics scorer, minus a Deflated-Sharpe threshold SR0(N, V[SR_archive]), minus a flat-attractor penalty; generated/bootstrapped paths used only as the White Reality Check null and as label-decoupled placebo panels; 2026H1 untouched hold-out; output = a bill-of-materials tactic library for the tactics panel row 1. The proposal's own thesis: the loop contributes no profit source; its only new information is the SELECTION RECORD (N_evaluated, V[SR], behaviour-descriptor coverage); the archive's market content is bounded by the cross-sectional IC of its terminals (TASK_915's direct estimand) except possibly for conjunctive/regime-gated structure; verdict "not worth a separate row, fold trial counter + DSR + placebo into row 1 / TASK_915".
lens: AMPLIFIER-NOT-SOURCE. Assume the loop only amplifies the information in its fitness targets (in-sample rule P&L). Ask what information the learned object carries that a direct estimator lacks; redo all arithmetic; audit gross/net, in-sample/OOS, years, and every literature number; default refuted=true if uncertain.
strongest_objection: The proposal identifies no information a direct estimator lacks, and the one surplus it names is already inside TASK_915. Its own text bounds the archive's market content by the cross-sectional IC of the grammar's terminals and reserves a single escape hatch — conjunctive / regime-gated structure ("IF vol-regime AND breakout THEN …") — as "the one candidate for information beyond a linear IC". But tasks/TASK_915_IC_CEILING_AND_GP_BOOK.md:16 pre-registers "Ridge + GBM only": a depth>=2 gradient-boosted tree over the same F1–F4 terminals IS a conjunctive-rule estimator, fitted to the market-residual target with a proper loss on ~2,800 x 273 (date, asset) observations, refit quarterly, causal, with Newey–West t and Bonferroni. The GP instead scores each candidate by ONE number — a full-span portfolio Sharpe over ~2,600 daily decisions, whose null SE is 1/sqrt(T_years) ≈ 0.37 (the block-bootstrap CI on the 819 PIT book, +0.56 CI[−0.13,+1.23], POWERED_RESULT.md, gives exactly that SE) — while the spread in TRUE Sharpe between the best real rule ever found on this surface (trend, full-span ≈ +0.5–0.8, dead since 2024 per LEDGER 898/trend-decay) and noise is of the same order. Selection at SNR ≈ 1 over 50 generations is hitchhiking, not learning; Allen–Karjalainen's evolved trees collapsing to "a 250-day moving average" (JFE 1999 p.262, read in the primary PDF) is what that looks like in print. So the loop is a strictly weaker conjunctive estimator than the GBM cell 915 already contains, run on ~273x fewer effective observations per decision, with a noisier objective, and its unique deliverable — the trial count N — is EXACT for a hashed 160-cell grid and UNDEFINED for a GP population (Bailey–López de Prado 2014 App. A.3: N must be independent trials; with M=25,000 correlated offspring and T=2,800 the paper says estimating the implied N̂ is "pointless" because T < ½M(M−1)). The loop therefore subtracts on both axes it claims: it is a worse estimator of the market than 915 and a worse accountant of multiplicity than a grid. Under H0 it manufactures the appearance of edge in proportion to ln N: with ~150 MAP-Elites niches x ~167 evaluations each, every niche elite reads E[max_167] ≈ 0.37 x 2.71 ≈ +1.0 in-sample on the full span and the archive's best ≈ 0.37 x 4.08 ≈ +1.5 (≈ +2.6 on 2024–26 alone) — an archive "full of +1.0 cells" on a market with no signal, which is the precise sense in which it is an amplifier of noise and not a source.
amplifier_check: VERDICT: amplifier only — and a low-efficiency one. (1) Targets: each candidate's fitness is its own in-sample net P&L; the GP has no other input about the market. Whatever conditional-mean information exists in daily OHLC on Kraken enters through the terminals, whose per-date cross-sectional IC is exactly what 915 measures with NW t >= 3 and Bonferroni (TASK_915:31-32). A thresholded, sign-quantised rule cannot carry more IC than the continuous terminals it is built from (the proposal concedes this), and the conjunctive exception is covered by 915's GBM (TASK_915:16). (2) The "new information" — the selection record — is information about the PROCEDURE, not the market: a hashed grid emits N exactly and can be run through eq.1–2 in 40 lines; the GP makes N ill-defined (correlated offspring, shared niche ancestry) and the design then plugs M=25,000 into a formula whose N is defined as independent trials (Bailey–López de Prado p.8, App. A.3, primary PDF). (3) Under H0 (IC ≈ 0, the memo's load-bearing doubt) the archive's content is the maximum of noise: E[max SR_N] = σ_SR·[(1−γ)Z⁻¹(1−1/N) + γZ⁻¹(1−1/(Ne))] — re-derived: N=10 → 1.57σ, N=100 → 2.53σ, N=1,000 → 3.25σ, N=25,000 → 4.08σ; with σ_SR = 0.63 (2.5 y) / 0.36 (7.7 y) that is +1.00/+1.60/+2.06/+2.58 and +0.57/+0.91/+1.17/+1.47 respectively — the proposal's figures check to two decimals, and 10 independent trials on the goalpost window clear +0.97 in expectation under pure noise. The repo has already observed this law: 813's best-of-132 minute-scale cell +5.81 (n_events=6) inverted to −4.08 CI[−7.27,−2.18] on the disjoint hold-out (PHASE1_MAP_PROBE.md, PHASE1_5_RESULT.md:25, both re-read); 819's best-of-8 +0.97 failed BH q=0.05 (PORTFOLIO_RESULT.md FDR table, best p 0.010) and re-cut PIT to +0.56 CI[−0.13,+1.23] (POWERED_RESULT.md). (4) The loop cannot even amplify efficiently: its fitness SE (≈0.37 full span; ≈0.63 on 2024–26) is comparable to the whole range of true fitness in G, so generation-over-generation selection is close to random search with an accountant who cannot count. (5) Bailey–López de Prado's memory corollary (pp.5–6, 11) makes the expected OOS value of the archive's best element NEGATIVE, not zero, on a mean-reverting series; the proposal's cost-drag figure (−0.15..−0.28 Sharpe per regime for a 0.155/day book at 21 bp) checks against POWERED_RESULT (BEAR22 +1.22 → +1.06; BULL24 +0.13 → −0.15; FULL +0.74 → +0.56). Net: the loop creates no information; it re-expresses the terminals' IC (if any) as a worse harvester (TC 0.5–0.7 for sign rules vs the GP aim portfolio) and, at IC ≈ 0, returns the maximum of noise plus a bill for it.

record_conflicts.conflict: For a parameter-free rule, every CPCV path contains the identical set of daily P&L observations (each group appears as a test group exactly once per path and nothing is trained), so all 5 'OOS-path' Sharpes are the same number = the full-sample in-sample Sharpe; purge and embargo act on a training set that is never used. Escape (b) 'CPCV replaces a single test window' is a no-op, and the 'median CPCV-OOS-path ≥ +0.97' half of gate (i) is passed under H0 with high probability (archive best ≈ +1.5 in-sample). The selection loop has strictly LESS train/test separation than the 1999 GP paper the proposal cites as its own precedent. Doing CPCV correctly (run the GP on training groups per split, score its elites on the test groups) costs ×15, not ×1.2.

surviving_claim: Three things survive, none of which is a self-learning loop and none of which needs one. (1) The E[max SR_N] arithmetic as a standing multiplicity reference for the program: on the 2024-01→2026-06 goalpost window ~10 effectively independent trials clear +0.97 in expectation under pure noise; ~200 do on the full 7.7-year PIT span; a rule grid graded on 2024–26 must therefore carry N <= ~50 and report SR0(N) beside every Sharpe — this belongs in TASK_915's SPEC and in tactics-panel row 1 as a reporting requirement, with N EXACT because the grid is hashed. (2) A label-decoupled placebo / White Reality Check harness on the unmodified trader.backtest.cell_metrics scorer (bh_fdr at :57 is the only multiplicity tool in-tree; 813 and 819 both used BH-FDR and neither computed a null max): positions from real features applied to a return panel circularly shifted by a common offset >= 365 d, block length from the 901 certified range estimators (range_probe.py:35-60), ~30–50 offsets spaced beyond the longest lookback, book-vol matched to the real book. Minutes of CPU on row 1's K≈8 tactics; reusable as a second read on 915's Bonferroni. (3) The ordering claim: run TASK_915 first; if G-A fails, every rule archive on daily OHLC is empty by construction and the evolutionary family needs no run to be retired. Conditional on G-A PASS, a readable threshold rule at the winning cell is an auditability concession costing ~30–50% of gross IR versus the Gârleanu–Pedersen book, obtainable from a hashed N <= 50 grid — the GP adds nothing to that either. Verdict on the operator's question: no self-learning loop that learns patterns to serve Monte Carlo evaluation on this surface escapes the record — the loop's targets are its own in-sample P&L, the Monte Carlo can only ever be the null it is tested against, and the honest form of the idea is a trial counter plus a placebo, not a learner. P(the loop finds an OOS-verified edge 915 would not) < 1%; P(a loop run without the gates reports a bar-clearing rule) ≈ 1.
kill_experiment_critique: The experiment as written cannot separate 'the loop is a noise amplifier' from 'there is a modest real edge', so it should not be run in this form. Defects, each with the fix: (a) GATE (iii) HAS NO POWER. DSR at N=25,000 sets SR0 = 4.08·σ_SR = +1.47 on the 7.7-year span and +2.58 on 2024–26 (eq.1, re-derived); DSR >= 0.95 then requires an observed Sharpe of ≈ +2.1 / +3.6 — a true +0.97 strategy passes with probability ≈ 0.001. Even with LdP-2019 clustering to N_eff ≈ 50, SR0 = +0.82 and the pass bar is ≈ +1.4 on the full span, still above the goalpost. Fix: drop the GP so N is exact and small (hashed grid, N <= 50 on 2024–26), or pre-register N_eff by clustering trial return correlations — and note Bailey–López de Prado App. A.3 says correlation-based N̂ is ill-conditioned when T < ½M(M−1), which M=25,000 vs T=2,800 violates by five orders of magnitude. (b) THE CPCV HALF OF GATE (i) IS THE IN-SAMPLE SHARPE. Parameter-free rules make all 5 paths identical (same daily P&L set), so 'median CPCV-OOS-path net@21 >= +0.97' is passed under H0 whenever the archive best exceeds +0.97 — expected +1.5 at N=25,000. Fix: either run the GP per CPCV split (×15 compute: ~150 CPU-h real arm, ~3,000 CPU-h placebos ≈ 4 CPU-days on 32 cores) or delete the CPCV language and say plainly that selection is in-sample and only (ii) carries the verdict. (c) THE HOLD-OUT HALF OF GATE (i) IS A COIN FLIP. 2026H1 ≈ 181 daily decisions → σ_SR = sqrt(365/181) ≈ 1.42; P(hold-out >= +0.97 | true 0) = 0.25, P(pass | true +0.97) = 0.50. The proposal concedes this in open_doubts #4 but keeps it as a PASS condition; it should be a sign/consistency report, not a gate (Bailey–López de Prado p.6: holdout does not control overfitting). (d) THE PLACEBO (ii) IS UNDER-REPLICATED AND MIS-MATCHED. 20 seeds → the '95th percentile' is the sample maximum; the 20 panels are 20 alignments of ONE return panel, not 20 markets, so best-of-archive under placebo is dominated by the shared 2021/2022 regimes; a common-offset shift misaligns the vol-scaling terminals with the return panel's vol regime, so placebo books have different realized vol than real books (the proposal flags this and defers the check). Fix: >= 30–50 offsets spaced beyond the 63-day lookback, book-vol matching enforced, and report the placebo distribution as the primary result. (e) GATE (iv) IS MIS-SCOPED AND UNCOSTED. Reality Check 'within the archive universe' tests the winners against the winners (anti-conservative); White's RC must run over the full evaluated universe — 25,000 rules × B=1,000 × ~1.5 s ≈ 10,000 CPU-h ≈ 13 CPU-days on 32 cores, absent from the compute line. (f) NO BY-YEAR REQUIREMENT. Selection is pooled over 2018-10→2025-12, which contains the 2021–2023 years where the trend signal was alive (LEDGER 898: 2021 +1.782, 2022 +1.074, 2023 +1.068 vs 2024 +0.041, 2025 +0.663, 2026H1 −1.659); an archive will re-discover the trend rule (as AK's did the 250-day MA), read ≈ +0.8 full-span in-sample from 2021–23 alone, and satisfy (i)'s CPCV half while being dead on the goalpost window. TASK_915 G-A demands IC > 0 in 2024, 2025 and 2026H1 separately; the kill experiment must carry the same clause. (g) INSTRUMENT PIN MISSING. Fitness is declared on 'the 819 POWERED PIT frame', which is close-only (trader/data.py:190-232, `_close_pit_daily.npz`); the grammar's range and volume terminals need a new PIT OHLCV frame, built and pinned per LEDGER.md:28-41 before the SPEC hash — not in the build estimate. (h) COST OF INFORMATION. After the fixes the experiment's information is entirely conditional on TASK_915 G-A (the proposal pre-commits 'do not run if G-A failed'); on G-A PASS the same rule can be read off a hashed N <= 50 grid in minutes. A corrected version therefore has no independent decision value and should not be a row; the pieces that survive (E[max] reference, placebo/RC harness, by-year and N-exact reporting) attach to TASK_915 and tactics-panel row 1.
